office_does: A Spokane County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; all judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Jennifer L. Fassbender is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Spokane County District Court judge since 2018 and Airway Heights Municipal Court judge 2009-2018; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since 2018; Airway Heights Municipal Court judge 2009-2018 [S1]
Secretary/treasurer of the state District and Municipal Court Judges' Association [S1]
Member of the Spokane County Law and Justice Council [S1]
